hypothesis: Squeeze: channel 49 writers scaled by 1e-4 and its DyT reader weights scaled up (least-squares linearisation) so normal tokens keep a linearised copy of the channel in MLP and query paths; flagged tokens saturate at ~1e4x and are hidden via the replaced key column; value column zeroed to avoid leakage.
